strikes.name: su_blade_fall
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. He rises tall with one blade hand cocked at the shoulder and the other hand up in guard, then folds down behind it and the edge of the hand falls on a slant onto the chest.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: he rises tall with one blade hand cocked at the shoulder and the other hand up in guard, then folds down behind it and the edge of the hand falls on a slant onto the chest

strikes.name: su_palm_arm
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A stepping palm: the striking hand drawn back close, then one straight line as the body steps through, the heel of the palm set on the rival arm.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a stepping palm: the striking hand drawn back close to him, then one straight line to the arm as the body steps through, the heel of the palm set on it; the lead hand open in guard

strikes.name: palm_turn
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. A turning palm-heel: the open hand carried out and round on the backfist arc and the heel of it set on the chest, the palm leading; he is turned away from the rival at the end of it.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: a turning palm-heel: the open hand carried out and round on the backfist arc, the arm bent through the turn, the heel of the palm set on the chest, the palm leading
